title: Mediocre Key Box
text:
Mediocre Key Box. We recently moved into our new home and when I saw this I thought it would be perfect for storing our keys at the garage door.

The design looks great and the wood of the box is solid. It has worked well but the hardware leaves a lot to be desired. Both the latch and the hinges are crafted from very soft metal that has not held up well to fail use.

At this price point I would expect better quality hardware. It is too bad that what would be a great product is made mediocre because of minor savings in hardware expense.

While this works I recommend looking for another that is made to hold up to daily use.
